summary_en: This Phase II study tests binimetinib together with imatinib in people with unresectable stage III or IV KIT-mutant melanoma. Binimetinib is taken by mouth twice a day and imatinib once a day, on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is a Phase II trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa binimetinib junto con imatinib en personas con melanoma KIT mutado, en estadio III o IV, que no se puede extirpar con cirugía. Binimetinib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día e imatinib una vez al día, en los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días. La medida principal de resultado no se indica; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Performance status of 2 or better (ECOG), or Karnofsky 60% or higher.
Confirmed melanoma that is unresectable, stage III or IV, and not suitable for local therapy.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 criteria.
KIT-mutant melanoma confirmed by a CLIA-certified test.
Progressed on prior standard therapy, or unable to tolerate it, per the investigator's opinion.
not_for: Systemic anticancer or antibody therapy within 3-4 weeks, or radiation within 2 weeks, before study start.
Another investigational agent within 14 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter.
Recent heart attack, bypass or stent within 6 months, heart failure, or LVEF below 50%.
Blood clot or stroke within 12 weeks of first dose, with some exceptions.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or inability to swallow and keep down study drugs.
